lesson_title: Our Tuck Shop Lost Money. The Receipts Told Us Why.
hook_text: Our class tuck shop lost R250 in one month. The receipts showed exactly why.
clip_script: March: R1 200 in sales, R1 450 on stock. That is a R250 loss. Panic. Then we checked our records: every till slip, every sale in the cash book. R300 of muffins went off. Waste. April: we made a budget first, bought only what we could sell, and put R100 a week into savings at the bank. Result: R1 400 in sales, R950 in costs, R450 profit. Plan, save, bank, record. Four habits that turn a loss into a lesson.
visual_style: A whiteboard tuck shop with a pile of mouldy muffins, a cash book and till slips, then a budget list and a growing savings jar.
mood: Honest and upbeat, a comeback story.
pacing: A dramatic loss reveal, a detective-style records check, then a quick turnaround.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and keep a cash book of your own money for one week.
